partition: public-development previously exposed; administrative label isolation only, not unseen evaluation
hypothesis: Existing counterexamples and equal-information packets can be made into an explicit BF mechanism protocol and executable E4 entry while E5 missing-information discovery has a falsifiable consumer-bound implementation contract.
paper_claim: BF mechanism/observation/consumer mapping, rich-static negative controls, frozen E4 protocol and runnable input gate, E5 discovery/qualification/consumption contract. No paid-format or autonomous-discovery benefit claim yet.
falsifier: Information differs across nominally equal-info arms, BF mechanisms are only renamed generic examples, static-rich is handicapped, expected labels leak to participants, or researcher-constructed expressions are relabeled Agent discovery.
targeted_tests: reuse and hash-readback two existing counterexamples and 16 packets
same facts/schema/tool resources across E4 arms
E5 visible assets vs independent target-label split
observation sources/units/costs and real consumer dependencies

e4.scoring: future intervention judgment; expected labels evaluator-only
e4.fixed: no external observation; local computation of supplied facts allowed
e4.active: same initial per-level data and observation API across formats; newly acquired facts/costs separately logged
e4.paid_execution: DISABLED; budgets/provider/usage and model lease require a subsequent S0-frozen batch

e5.scope: contract and validator only; genuine Agent discovery, independent qualification and real-consumer experiment NOT_RUN
e5.selection: Agent chooses from a general legal observation catalogue, no relevant-field/target-observation labels
e5.construction: Agent proposes a BF relation and executable observation; no expression supplied in discovery arm
e5.construction_baseline: Existing human-specified headroom AST/compiler and researcher-required-field selector retained as baselines
e5.consumer_requirement: kernel-registered consumer plus input-observation/execution/independent-service binding; static echo or a self-signed receipt cannot establish use

claim_boundary: Public BF development computational evidence only. No hardware, unseen transfer, method benefit, or RSI claim from preparation or a current-task repair. Original ten owners/projects, Baseline, Demo, every experiment/cost/UNKNOWN and four closed H attempts stay preserved.
stop_condition: Stop dependent execution on baseline/hash drift, model/backend ambiguity, unavailable usage, insufficient declared reserve, hidden-evaluator access, unknown native state or need to alter frozen task semantics; retain no-go and every failed/charged attempt. A legal-space infeasibility goes to the human as concrete options; independent work continues.
reproducible_command: rtk proxy env PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=packages/python/bfworld/src <CAD_PYTHON> -B scripts/campaign_bf_interfaces.py prepare --profile <registered-profile> --output <new-absolute-output>
